title: Narrowest Band Across All Playlists
description:
## Task

Several playlists each hold song lengths in seconds, every playlist sorted in non-decreasing order. Find the narrowest inclusive range `[lo, hi]` of lengths such that every playlist has at least one song whose length lies in the range. A range is narrower than another when `hi - lo` is smaller; on a tie choose the one with the smaller `lo`.

## Input

- `playlists` — a non-empty list of non-empty lists of integers, each inner list sorted in non-decreasing order.

## Output

A list `[lo, hi]`.

## Example

```python
narrowest_band([[4, 10, 15, 24, 26], [0, 9, 12, 20], [5, 18, 22, 30]])  # returns [20, 24]
narrowest_band([[3], [3], [3]])  # returns [3, 3]
```

## Constraints

- 1 ≤ number of playlists ≤ 3500
- 1 ≤ length of each playlist, total songs ≤ 10^5
- -10^6 ≤ each length ≤ 10^6
